items.headline: Connelly Week 6 preview: Things get real with SEC, Big Ten showdowns
items.description: With Georgia-Alabama, major challenges for Big Ten unbeatens and some Big 12 chaos, there's a lot to follow.

items.headline: Pac-12 matchup features No. 23 Boise State against Fresno State
items.description: No. 23 Boise State (4-1) at Fresno State (4-1), Oct. 10 at 10:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Fresno State wins Pac-12 debut, beats Washington State 26-6
items.description: — Wide receiver Josiah Freeman scored on a reverse and Fresno State beat Washington State 23-6 on Saturday night in the inaugural game for both teams in the new-look Pac-12 Conference.

items.headline: Washington State hosts Fresno State in Pac-12 action
items.description: Fresno State (3-1) at Washington State (1-3), Oct. 3 at 9:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Jayden Mandal, Rayshon Luke lead Fresno State to 38-24 victory over Rice
items.description: — Jayden Mandal threw three touchdown passes and Rayshon Luke rushed for 167 yards and a score to lead Fresno State to a 38-24 victory over Rice on Saturday night.
